WITH customer_total_return AS (
    SELECT cr_returning_customer_sk as ctr_customer_sk, ca_state as ctr_state, SUM(cr_return_amt_inc_tax) as ctr_total_return 
    FROM catalog_returns 
        JOIN date_dim ON cr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2001
        JOIN customer_address ON cr_returning_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
    GROUP BY ctr_customer_sk, ctr_state 
), avg_total_returns AS (
    SELECT ctr_state, AVG(ctr_total_return) as avg_plus_20pct
    FROM customer_total_return
    GROUP BY ctr_state
), joined_data AS (
    SELECT c_customer_sk, ca_address_sk, ca_state, ctr_total_return
    FROM customer_total_return 
        JOIN avg_total_returns ON customer_total_return.ctr_state = avg_total_returns.ctr_state
)
SELECT *
FROM joined_data 
    JOIN customer_address ON ca_address_sk = c_current_addr_sk AND ca_state = 'TN'
    JOIN customer ON joined_data.c_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
WHERE ctr_total_return > avg_plus_20pct * 1.2
ORDER BY c_customer_id,c_salutation,c_first_name,c_last_name,ca_street_number,ca_street_name 
            ,ca_street_type,ca_suite_number,ca_city,ca_county,ca_state,ca_zip,ca_country,ca_gmt_offset  
            ,ca_location_type,ctr_total_return 
LIMIT 100
